Class LibraryService

java.lang.Object
service.LibraryService
public class LibraryService extends Object
In-memory business logic for the library. This class contains no GUI code so it can be tested headlessly.
Author:
Syeda Momina Sherazi (534663), Muqaddus Habib (534742)

  • Method Details

    • addBook

      public void addBook(String id, String title, String author) throws LibraryException
      Adds a book after checking that the ID is unique and the text fields are not empty.
      Parameters:
      id - unique identifier of the new book
      title - title of the new book
      author - author of the new book
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if the ID or text fields are empty, or the ID is already used

    • findById

      public Book findById(String id)
      Looks up a book by its ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID to search for
      Returns:
      the matching book, or null when no book has that ID

    • getAll

      public List<Book> getAll()
      Returns all books in insertion order.
      Returns:
      a new list containing every book currently stored

    • updateBook

      public void updateBook(String id, String title, String author) throws LibraryException
      Replaces the title and author of an existing book.
      Parameters:
      id - ID of the book to update
      title - new title
      author - new author
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if the book does not exist, or a text field is empty

    • deleteBook

      public void deleteBook(String id) throws LibraryException
      Removes a book from the library.
      Parameters:
      id - ID of the book to remove
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if no book has that ID

    • setStatus

      public void setStatus(String id, BookStatus status) throws LibraryException
      Sets the loan status of an existing book.
      Parameters:
      id - ID of the book to change
      status - one of AVAILABLE, ISSUED or RESERVED
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if the book does not exist, or the status is null
